param: α₁ Recruitment into susceptible population (inflow to S)
α₂ Recruitment/importation into infected population (inflow to I)
ψ₁ Effective contact rate with infectious humans (direct transmission)
ψ₂ Effective contact rate with environmental pathogens (indirect transmission)
ψ₃ Effective contact rate with deceased humans (funeral/burial transmission)
ε Natural death rate of humans
ρ₁ Disease-induced death rate of infected humans
ρ₂ Shedding rate of infected humans into environment
ρ₃ Quarantine rate of infected humans
ω₁ Recovery rate of quarantined humans
ω₂ Death rate of quarantined humans due to infection
h Shedding/contamination rate from deceased humans into environment
c Burial/removal rate of deceased humans
b Clearance/decay rate of Ebola pathogens in the environment
d External input into environmental pathogen compartment
Ω₁ Auxiliary quantity used in stability analysis (paper defines Ω₁ from model parameters)
Ω₂ Sum of outflow rates from infected (paper: Ω₂ = ρ₁+ρ₂+ρ₃+ε)
Ω₃ Sum of outflow rates from quarantined (paper uses ω₁+ω₂+ε)
Ω₄ Sum of outflow/removal-related rates for deceased (paper uses Ω₄ = h + c)
